safety.confidence_note: The bundled FDA multidisciplinary reviews (761232, 761380, 761417) lack OCR text for the nonclinical body, so the monkey findings were not read; all three BLAs are tislelizumab in other indications.
safety.note: Tislelizumab's 3-month monkey study (summarised in its 2024 ESCC label) named no harm checkable in ENKTL patients; track opens at the model's first use (2016).
safety.quote: In a 3-month repeat-dose toxicology study in cynomolgus monkeys, there were no notable effects in the male and female reproductive organs
safety.reason: Monkey study named no checkable harm
safety.judgement: Opened at model_first_use_year (2016) per rule 6, as the checker adjudicated; the 2024 label is the source. The label states no harm checkable in ENKTL trials (reproductive organs were not measured), and the ENKTL trials reported the usual immune-related events without reference to a monkey prediction.
